receipts.first_text_witness: One of the best performing stocks in America right now is a chain of pawn shops, not a tech company, not an AI lab, a pawn shop chain. I need you to sit with how strange that is for a second because it's the whole video. There's a man named Jacob sliding a Snap-on tool set across a pawn counter in suburban Detroit. $3,000 of tools, the exact tools he uses to make a living. He's an HVAC tech, 80,000 a year, and he'll show up to a job tomorrow morning. By every official definition, he's doing fine, and he's pawning his livelihood to make it to Friday. Here's the part that should bother you. The company that just took Jacob's tools, its stock has doubled in a year while the S&P 500 returned a fraction of that. Same economy, one man pawning his livelihood, one chart going vertical off the back of it. My name's Nick, and today we're figuring out why both are true at once, and which one you should actually believe.
